issues: The UI requirements R10-R13, R14-R20 concerning layout of buttons, snackbar placement, bottom tab bar visibility, screen titles, date picker icon placement, spacing, scan receipt button visibility, settings layout, and delete all data styling are not implemented. The code changes only modify validation, mileage screen, and category rename logic, but do not adjust UI components such as DashboardScreen, ReceiptEntryScreen, SettingsScreen, BottomActionBar, ScreenHeader, PrimaryButton, SimpleAddButtons, or related layout components to satisfy the specified UI requirements.
Missing implementation for BottomActionBar to include receipt and mileage FABs, expose a prop for Snackbar above content, and ensure the FABs do not overlay the Recent activity list (R10, R12).
DashboardScreen does not wrap the Recent activity ScrollView with appropriate paddingBottom for the FAB height, nor does it ensure the bottom tab labels are fully visible on a 390x844 screen (R13).
ReceiptEntryScreen still renders the screen title "Add Receipt" in the body and places the date picker icon outside the Date FormField (violating R14 and R15).
There are extra spacers larger than the standard spacing between input fields on the Add receipt screen (violating R16).
The "Scan receipt" button is not conditionally rendered based on expo-text-extractor.isSupported (R17).
SettingsScreen still contains a separate "App lock" button instead of a single switch row, and other entries are not converted to SimpleListItem rows with chevron icons (R18, R19).
The Delete all data entry is not styled in the error color, placed last, and separated by a Divider (R20).
feedback: The code passes all existing tests, but it does not implement the UI changes required by the task description. The acceptance tests for UI layout are not present, but the requirements list specifies several UI constraints that must be satisfied. Implement the missing UI adjustments in the relevant screen and component files to meet requirements R10-R20, then re-run the test suite to ensure everything still passes.
